data.paraphrase: For every natural number N greater than 0, and for every function a defined on the interval [1, N], and for every function f defined as the sum from j=1 to N of a(j) multiplied by the sine of 2πj times t, and for every function mult that assigns to each function g a function from real numbers to natural numbers, and for every function M defined as the sum from k=0 to infinity of the k-th derivative of f multiplied by t, it holds that M is non-decreasing, and as N approaches infinity, M approaches 2N.
